sources.title: Introducing DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: smarter, faster, more efficient.
sources.snippet: Introducing the smallest model in our new architecture family, with native visual understanding. Designed for greater capability, faster inference, and higher throughput.

sources.title: DeepSeek | Into the Unknown
sources.snippet: DeepSeek is an AI research company focused on building world-leading general artificial intelligence. We develop and open-source frontier LLMs including DeepSeek-V4, DeepSeek-R1, and DeepSeek-Coder. Chat with DeepSeek AI or integrate via API.

sources.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash vision-language MoE (552B backbone; 8B active per prompt token, 16B per output token) combining sliding-window plus compressed sparse attention with a two-level indexer, engram n-gram memory, hyper-connections, and a DSpark multi-token draft head.
